# Reference internal-text caller

Pinned MathJax 3.2.2 (`ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`), from the three hash-checked D2 v0.8.1 assets. `generate_reference_text.cjs` runs 29 ordinary public conversions and 17 actual registered `BaseMethods.HandleRef` method calls, writing outputs to a supplied scratch directory. Its two observer bodies delegate the original methods; the primary algorithms are not replaced. The committed fixtures are derived from previously frozen, untouched primary captures.

The production change replaces HandleRef's literal `textRow` with the existing `internalMath` caller. Literal reference text inherits the caller font; embedded math uses that helper's existing empty lexical environment and shared configuration. Empty, single and mixed returned children go directly into the enclosing reference row. An inner error returns before that row is created, while prior shared color effects persist.

The public test requires whole SVG and complete explicit/own-property trees for all 29 cases, including isolated bold/italic inline reference fixes, missing/unknown labels, escaping, argument errors and reused compiler calls. It does not certify the separate rich-tag/equation composites. The full 48-case observations retain 19 unresolved whole outputs: D083's rendered-tag parsing and D101's responsive root minimum width. All 38 rendered reference cases have reference subtrees that agree with primary after this caller change; the other ten observations are errors with no reference. These component observations are not 48 passing whole formulas. The 64-case D083 comparison remains separate; only its four rich references change, while its tag discrepancy remains open.

The private test uses all 17 actual method fixtures, including cursor/tail, shared labels/color identity, inherited literal font, fresh embedded-math macro count, nesting, cardinality and error-before-outer-row behavior. Five precisely named pre-Compile token paths carry existing Go lexical markers; `reference_text_method_boundaries.json` binds their full maps to unchanged accepted `internalMath` outputs on `787559bb`. Only those markers are projected for private primary comparison; all raw maps remain in the capture evidence and public post-Compile trees are strict. The primary observer's MissingArgFor command name and the unchanged unclosed-argument cursor are separately explicit, single-case boundaries, not new product fixes.

Persistent primary document label storage, allLabels/refUpdate, custom base URL and configured internalMath callbacks are outside the represented public Go API. Their primary captures remain observational; this change does not invent corresponding configuration or lifecycle behavior. D083/D101 and these boundaries are not candidate-backed whole-output expectations.
